body:
#### PR description:

- Part of the migration of the scheduling system to be more flexible.
- The API to talk to modules is now through TransitionWorker which knows the transition to which it is defined
- The TransitionWorker for the Event has a different API than the others to reflect how it is presently used
#### PR validation:

Framework code compiles and framework unit tests pass.
title: Specialize workers for Event
